old_clauses.reading: Weaving, as opposed to unweaving, the cloth.
old_clauses.binding: A=[WEAVE,UNRAVEL], both with patient C. Action names only; zero executed actions.

old_clauses.reading: Completion of the cloth is a prerequisite for marriage.
old_clauses.binding: P=prerequisite(FINISHED(C),MARRIAGE(W)); neither completion nor marriage is asserted here.

old_clauses.reading: In secret, the woman unravels the cloth.
old_clauses.binding: U=habitual UNRAVEL(W,C), concealed from public participants O. qoky introduces W; otchey introduces concealed status. No exact nightly quantity.

old_clauses.reading: By day she publicly pledges that prerequisite.
old_clauses.binding: PLEDGE(W,O,P,DAY). The pledge takes C2, the most recent proposition of prerequisite type; C3 is an action, not an eligible proposition.

old_clauses.reading: Until the cloth is finished, she weaves it row by row.
old_clauses.binding: V=habitual WEAVE(W,C), prospectively bounded by FINISHED(C), with ROW ROW interpreted distributively. The endpoint is not asserted as reached by this clause.

old_clauses.reading: The first and second activities on that cloth have daytime and nighttime, respectively.
old_clauses.binding: C1 first=WEAVE binds C5 V to DAY; C1 second=UNRAVEL binds C3 U to NIGHT. qokedy requires the same C. No new action or event is introduced.

old_clauses.reading: A handmaid informs the wooers; they discover the concealed action at night.
old_clauses.binding: INFORM(H,O,U); DISCOVER(O,U,NIGHT). The written qody is the report recipient and following discovery subject. The common concealed-action object is U. Discovery does not manufacture a further unweaving event.

old_clauses.reading: Then, under compulsion, the woman weaves the cloth to completion.
old_clauses.binding: After C7 discovery: actual WEAVE(W,C) under compulsion, capped by SAII at FINISHED(C). Neither a marriage nor an additional unweaving is asserted.
